decisions.reason: The non-military person definition directly explains civilian and carries an informal label. The separate manufactured-cigarette slang meaning is excluded.
Sour/curdled raw milk is not necessarily yogurt. The source does not validate the proposed Fitness nutrition equivalence or a safe fermentation interpretation.
The collarbone definition describes its chest/shoulder location and connections, directly supporting Fitness anatomy. The separate fish-bone sense is excluded.
No exact English factual candidate was extracted for the proposed highly technical collarbone term. The verified clavicle record does not automatically approve a different identity.
The musical keyboard meaning is explicitly tied to organ, pianoforte and harmonium, fitting the piano anchor. It does not mean a computer keyboard or necessarily the entire instrument.

The intended medical training sense has a curriculum-stage restriction, while other meanings concern clerical work or judges. The general TOEIC internship link does not resolve that specialized context.
No exact factual candidate was returned for this hyphenated identity. A plausible scientific gloss alone is insufficient for publication.
A defendant joined with others in one action is a complete sourced legal noun relevant to business/legal processes. It is not a blanket synonym for every respondent.
An equal person or thing is the appropriate noun for the peer anchor. Do not mix it with an adjective or limit all uses to equality before law.
No exact plural funds/reserves definition was extracted from the checked sources. Preserve the unverified treasury gloss hidden rather than borrowing an unrelated container meaning.
Notice or awareness is self-contained and directly matches the awareness anchors. The jurisdiction and heraldic-badge senses are excluded, as is the unrelated Fitness expansion.
A current or former college student is clear academic vocabulary. Preserve that wider membership meaning rather than treating it as exclusively a current undergraduate; ignore prison slang.
The source explains finely divided dispersed material and its medium, a coherent Academic mixture concept related to aerosols. Other particle-size and glue-like adjective meanings are excluded.
Conversation/dialogue is a direct match for dialog. Preserve the explicit formal label without adding church-court, trial-procedure or classical-textbook senses.
Loose rock/soil debris accumulated at a slope's foot is a precise earth-science meaning. Restrict the specialist extension to Academic, not a generic substitute for deposit.
No exact factual participle/adjective candidate was extracted. The model's process-versus-state comparison is not enough to publish a sourced meaning.
The plant/oilseed meaning is not established by the ordinary Business rape anchor. Keep the homonym/topic mismatch hidden, even though the botanical word is valid.
Courtesy, considerate behavior and social harmony are a self-contained general meaning related to friendly relations. No treaty or institutional legal doctrine is implied.
Serving to compliment is explained directly and matches complimentary praise. The ecclesiastical benefice meaning and official-praise-only restriction are not selected.
The source explicitly adds equal or proportionate to the manner definition, resolving its meaning. Do not imply it is interchangeable with equally in every construction.

The terse relating-to-commentary candidate does not establish the intended analytical alternative to editorial. Keep scope and learner explanation uncertain rather than promoting the old model comparison.
Bringing an idea/prototype into commerce is explicitly explained and relevant to Business. The old privatization equivalence is rejected: changing commercial availability need not change ownership.
Sorrow for another's hardship and compassion are explained directly. Restrict to general English rather than inheriting an unsupported Fitness-specific or extra-formal use.
No exact self-contained plural candidate was extracted for traded goods. The economic/raw-material meaning needs attributable evidence tied to this record, not a guessed singular import.
Shared attributes or characteristics is a clear Academic comparison concept. Explicitly reject the old incidence/frequency equivalence and keep that relationship unreviewed.
The headword appears to have lost its accented ending and no exact candidate was found. A source-backed communiqué identity correction is needed before an announcement meaning can be released.
A state's change to a lesser penalty is explicitly sourced and fits legal substitution. Payment exchange, phonemes and electric-current reversal are different senses and excluded.
A tendency to yield to another's will is a full explanation appropriate to willingness/compliance. It must not be confused with complacency or a universal desirable trait.
No exact plural constituent-parts candidate was extracted. Preserve the record hidden until its factual definition is bound to the intended physical/abstract parts sense.
The chief accountant of a company/government is a self-contained role definition. It does not make every accountant, director or ship's purser a comptroller; no such links are promoted.
Controlling a function/process/creation by computer is the exact supported Business verb. Other senses about storing information or providing computers are not mixed into this release.
The retained candidate is only a spelling cross-reference to computerised, with no standalone meaning. Do not treat spelling identity as a complete sourced definition.
The source explicitly explains being conceived, believed or understood. This supports theoretical possibility, not a claim about numerical likelihood or actual probability.
The only candidate repeats conceptualizes and does not explain forming concepts independently. The earlier model's design/theory distinction is insufficient evidence.
The only source says in a concerted manner without explaining coordination. Do not publish the model's deliberate-cooperation comparison as dictionary evidence.
A holder of a granted right to conduct a business is explained directly and fits business concessions. It is not limited to utilities or food stands.
Someone trying to bring peace is a standalone meaning relevant to reconciling opposing parties. It resolves the circular conciliates definition without asserting a formal legal office.
At the same time as something else is clear timing vocabulary appropriate to the simultaneous-action anchors. It does not automatically imply causation or statistical correlation.
The rounded mineral mass in sedimentary rock/ocean-floor context is a clear earth-science meaning related to stone. Reject the unrelated mathematical-calculus connection and medical-stone senses.
Events happening at the same time is explained directly and fits general planning. Avoid the specialized computing definition that could conflate concurrency with simultaneous parallel execution.
